title: User detail shows access summary and suspend confirm
summary: Admin user detail now summarises job roles and capability packs instead of dumping every effective permission, and suspending an account requires an explicit confirmation checkbox.
changes: Replace the raw effective-permission list on Admin user detail with a job-role and capability-pack summary; keep fine-grained permissions under Advanced.
Require an explicit confirm checkbox before suspend, and add a jump link to the suspend form from the account summary.
version_rationale: Patch release: improves Admin user detail readability and adds a suspend confirm gate without changing who may suspend or which permissions apply.
validation: PHPUnit AdminUserDetailUxTest covers the access summary UI and suspend confirm validation gate.
PHPUnit AdminAccessAndViewsTest and AdminRoleAndUserManagementTest updated for Advanced permission markup and confirm field.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
known_limitations: Fine-grained permissions remain available under Advanced for any Admin who can view the account; Super Admin–only hiding was not required for this release.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version to restore the raw effective-permission dump and suspend-without-confirm behaviour.
provenance: User detail access summary and suspend confirm for issues #137 and #144, pull request #237.
